items.claim: Uros Medic consistently catches opponents with big shots early in fights.
items.quote: Medic catches everyone with big shots early.

items.claim: D-Rod has shown good recoverability throughout most of his career, such as coming back to win after being badly hurt against Kevin Holland.
items.quote: he's shown good recoverability throughout most of his career, honestly. Notably, in that Kevin Holland fight recently, he was completely done in that fight.

items.claim: Uros Medic is a hard-hitting first-round knockout artist who recently knocked out the durable Jeff Neil.
items.quote: Uros Medic, who hits really hard, who is a first round knockout artist at the end of the day, who just knocked out Jeff Nil, who pretty durable himself.

items.claim: D-Rod possesses veteran experience that he could potentially use to manage distance and avoid early power.
items.quote: he could use some veteran savvy to use his footwork. Maybe it's not got great footwork, but he's a veteran.
